name: Short Course - Invalid Course Code
description: POSTs a short course with course code ZSC00404 — the das-commitments-stubs Courses API stub hardcodes this one code to return a 404 lookup response (any other unrecognised code falls through to the default successful lookup and would NOT reproduce this). The 404 causes ShortCourseLookupService to throw InvalidCourseException, which ShortCoursesController maps to a 422 response.

steps.name: SLD Create a Short Course with an unknown course code
